title: .NET support policy
finding: .NET 10 is an active LTS release; exact patch must be revalidated at kickoff.
fit: Adopt runtime family; pin current supported patch.

title: System.CommandLine package
finding: Stable 2.x package provides parsing, validation, async actions, and completion foundations.
fit: Adopt parser; isolate public CLI contract from library APIs.

title: Windows ML overview
finding: Local ONNX inference with CPU/GPU/NPU execution-provider management on supported Windows.
fit: Preferred adapter candidate, not a hard dependency until SPIKE-003.

title: Windows ML distribution
finding: Self-contained and framework-dependent deployment modes have size/control tradeoffs.
fit: Prototype self-contained for predictable offline deployment.

title: ONNX Runtime documentation
finding: Cross-platform local inference runtime with execution providers and C# API.
fit: Required abstraction target and CPU fallback candidate.
license_note: MIT for project; bundled providers reviewed separately

title: OpenCV YuNet model documentation
finding: Small face detector with bounding boxes and five landmarks; ONNX artifact available.
fit: Baseline model candidate for four-rotation scoring.
license_note: Repository/model licenses must both be recorded and verified

title: YuNet research paper
finding: Documents a compact edge-oriented face detector and performance/accuracy tradeoffs.
fit: Supports model hypothesis; does not establish orientation accuracy.
license_note: Open-access article terms; model terms separate

title: OpenCV FaceDetectorYN API
finding: API returns face rectangle, five landmarks, and score.
fit: Reference post-processing contract; production may call ONNX directly.

title: ExifTool application documentation
finding: Broad metadata read/write support and `-stay_open` command protocol.
fit: Strong metadata adapter candidate; subprocess hardening and redistribution review required.
license_note: Perl Artistic License/GPL option; confirm executable redistribution details

title: ExifTool tag names
finding: Comprehensive field/group semantics and raw/print-converted values.
fit: Basis for field-aware metadata preservation policy.

title: libjpeg-turbo
finding: High-performance JPEG implementation with lossless transform support and jpegtran `-perfect` behavior.
fit: Adopt behind transform adapter after SPIKE-005.

title: jpegtran manual
finding: Documents lossless rotate/flip/transverse/transpose, marker copy, trim, and perfect modes.
fit: Defines expected CLI semantics; qualify bundled version directly.
license_note: Documentation and binary licenses tracked separately

title: ReplaceFileW
finding: Windows replacement primitive intended to preserve selected original-file properties while replacing data.
fit: Candidate atomic commit primitive for supported local filesystems.

title: Windows Imaging Component overview
finding: Runtime codec discovery and metadata support for standard Windows image workflows.
fit: Capability/fallback adapter candidate; optional codecs vary by machine.

title: Magick.NET
finding: Managed ImageMagick binding with broad format coverage and architecture-specific packages.
fit: Candidate general raster/format adapter; package size, policy.xml, delegates, and licensing require qualification.

title: Microsoft.Data.Sqlite package
finding: Lightweight ADO.NET SQLite provider compatible with current .NET.
fit: Adopt for local job store after SPIKE-008.
license_note: MIT; SQLite native component public-domain with bundle notices

title: SQLite WAL documentation
finding: WAL provides concurrency/durability tradeoffs and checkpoint behavior.
fit: Evaluate for job store; do not use over unsupported network filesystems.

title: xUnit.net
finding: xUnit v3 supports modern .NET and common test runners.
fit: Adopt unit/integration test framework; pin current stable at kickoff.

title: BenchmarkDotNet
finding: Reproducible .NET microbenchmark harness with environment reporting.
fit: Use for component microbenchmarks, not corpus/E2E quality metrics.

title: ImageMagick auto-orient
finding: `-auto-orient` applies EXIF orientation but does not infer missing/wrong visual orientation.
fit: Useful semantics/reference; insufficient as complete solution.

title: jhead JPEG camera header tool
finding: Can autorotate JPEGs using EXIF orientation and invoke jpegtran.
fit: Valid prior art for EXIF-only workflows; lacks visual inference, durable jobs, review, and professional safety model.

title: RotNet paper
finding: Self-supervised rotation prediction can learn image orientation representations.
fit: Alternative scene model research; no direct production adoption without domain calibration.

title: RotBench paper
finding: Rotation/orientation benchmarks highlight dataset and shortcut risks; exact candidate paper must be pinned during SPIKE-001.
fit: Informs evaluation design, not a production dependency.

title: MediaPipe Face Detector
finding: Cross-platform face detection task with local models and landmarks.
fit: Reserve candidate; larger integration surface than needed for five-point geometry and must be benchmarked before substitution.

title: Spectre.Console
finding: Rich terminal rendering for .NET applications.
fit: Optional human renderer only; never allowed to contaminate machine stdout.

title: Microsoft SBOM Tool
finding: Generates SPDX SBOMs for build artifacts.
fit: Candidate CI supply-chain output; qualify current release at packaging spike.

title: Sigstore Cosign
finding: Artifact signing/attestation ecosystem; Windows executable signing still requires Authenticode.
fit: Optional provenance attestation complement, not replacement for code signing.

title: Windows long paths
finding: Long-path support depends on application manifest and system policy/API usage.
fit: Required compatibility and test input.

title: microsoft/vstest
finding: VSTest platform hosts .NET test execution for dotnet test.
fit: Test host dependency pinned for deterministic CI.

title: Coverlet
finding: Cross-platform .NET code coverage collector integrated with VSTest.
fit: Diagnostic coverage collection; coverage is not a sole gate.
